_about: Acetonitrile (1) + Ethylene glycol (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.3 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of acetonitrile, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of acetonitrile, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Qian, G.-f.[Guo-fei], Liu, W.[Wen], Wang, L.-t.[Li-tao], Wang, D.-c.[Dao-cai], Song, H.[Hang], (Vapour + liquid) equilibria in the ternary system (acetonitrile + n-propanol + ethylene glycol) and corresponding binary systems at 101.3 kPa, J. Chem. Thermodyn. 67 (2013) 241-246
